shipped.evidence: Measured 113 rows, 70 foreign across 8 nonexistent synthetic*.report-bridge.com domains; the newest row in the table was foreign. Guard at recordDeliveryEvent, the seam every write passes. 12 of 26 new assertions fail against the old code. delivery-events.ts had NO test file before this.

shipped.title: the mail dead-man's switch had been disarmed since its first event
shipped.evidence: healthy = count(*)>0 over an append-only table = permanently true once the first event landed. Rebuilt against a send-side record (migration 031: provider id + timestamp, no recipient, no body). Live-proven on production: one ripe unheard send turned it false, one heard send turned it back, proof rows removed.
shipped.alsoFound: migration 030's GRANT ON ALL TABLES resolves once, so 031 locked relay_dev out of the table it had just created. 032 fixes the cause with ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES (verified supported on DSQL). verify:schema now probes readability too, proven by planting a REVOKE and watching it fail in both regions.

shipped.title: no fetch names a route nothing serves
shipped.evidence: Tree clean: 63 fetch sites, 75 routes. The check was WRONG TWICE on the way — a nested template literal produced a false positive, and the obvious repair let a real planted typo pass green. Both are now cases in the file. Proven by planting in the tree, not in a fixture array.

shipped.title: the rebuilt switch could be disarmed the same way, one layer down
